summary: BioNTech SE filed a Form 6-K on August 4, 2026, reporting its quarterly results for the three and six months ended June 30, 2026. The filing contains unaudited interim condensed consolidated financial statements, operating and financial review, and risk factors. The company reported a net loss of €820.8 million and €1,352.7 million for the respective periods, with revenues of €105.6 million and €223.7 million. No special-situation transaction or corporate event is described; this is a routine periodic financial report.
